summary: Frontend-only verification of Navbar changes (mobile hamburger dropdown) and AdminMessages changes (row-level eye button, tall panel, mobile back button as first item of conv strip). NAVBAR passes fully on both desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844). ADMIN MESSAGES: UI rendering passes (eye buttons present, old header toggle removed, panel height ~772px with h-[calc(100vh-8rem)]), BUT the eye toggle button is BROKEN at runtime — clicking it throws ReferenceError: toggleConvActive is not defined. State does not change (inactive badge stays the same before/after click).

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime ReferenceError: `toggleConvActive is not defined`. Line 224 calls `toggleConvActive(c.candidate_id, c.active)` but the function is never declared in the file. Only `toggleActive` (line ~116, no args, uses `active` state) exists. Result: clicking [data-testid='conv-toggle-active-<candidateId>'] throws in console (Uncaught runtime errors overlay appears) and the active/inactive state does NOT toggle. This makes the entire feature (C) non-functional.

integration_issues.flow: Toggle conversation active/inactive from list row
integration_issues.issue: PUT /api/chat/conversations/{id}/active is never called because the handler crashes before invocation. Verified: badge count before=0 and after=0 for candidate user_edfafbeb0789 (initially active); after click, no change and console shows ReferenceError.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminMessages.jsx add a `toggleConvActive(candidateId, currentActive)` function that PUTs /api/chat/conversations/{candidateId}/active with { active: !currentActive } and then calls loadConvs() (mirror the existing `toggleActive` implementation at line ~116 but parameterized). Wrap in try/catch with toast messages. After fix, re-verify by clicking the eye button and confirming: (a) no runtime error, (b) `conv-inactive-<id>` badge toggles, (c) icon switches Eye <-> EyeOff.

Also verify mobile flow (390x844) once the fix is in: open Messages via nav-messages, tap a conversation, confirm [data-testid='mobile-conv-strip'] appears with [data-testid='mobile-back-btn'] as its FIRST child, and no back button exists inside the chat header row.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminMessages.jsx: undefined function reference `toggleConvActive` — a build/lint step (eslint no-undef) would have caught this. Recommend enabling react/no-undef and pre-commit lint.

AdminMessages.jsx is likely >700 lines and mixes many responsibilities (list, chat, calls, recording, attachments, selection, filter). Consider splitting into ConversationList, ChatPanel, and hooks (useConversations, useChatMessages).
Frontend runtime errors surface via an overlay (dev mode). Ensure error boundaries + toast fallback in production so users don't see a blank/broken interaction.

rca of the issue: RCA: In /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminMessages.jsx line 224, the conversation-row eye button onClick invokes `toggleConvActive(c.candidate_id, c.active)`. Grep confirms no function/const with that name exists in the file. The refactor that moved activation from the chat header into the conversation list introduced the JSX call but forgot to define the corresponding handler (or forgot to rename the existing `toggleActive` at line ~116, which is parameterless and reads the `active` state). Reproduction: login as admin, open Messages, click any [data-testid^='conv-toggle-active-']. Expected: PUT /api/chat/conversations/{id}/active with active toggled; badge/icon updates. Actual: Uncaught ReferenceError: toggleConvActive is not defined; no network call; UI unchanged. Mitigation: add `const toggleConvActive = async (candidateId, currentActive) => { try { await api.put(`/chat/conversations/${candidateId}/active`, { active: !currentActive }); toast.success(!currentActive ? 'Conversation activée' : 'Conversation désactivée'); loadConvs(); } catch { toast.error('Échec de mise à jour'); } };` inside the component before the return statement.
